resources.string: You try other people\'s apps and they try yours, so nobody here has to find testers alone.
Ask the Circle to try your app and tell you what works and what doesn\'t. You pay for reviews in tix and earn tix by reviewing other apps.
14 days of testing,\none night at a time.
Join a crew to get the closed test Google asks for. Each night you open the other apps, and you can see what is left in one place.
Paste your Play link or package name. We fill in the app\'s name and icon, so you can ask for feedback or take a crew seat.
Browse the Circle and Crew without an account. Sign in when you want to take part.
